title: The USSR Deleted This Man While He Was Still Alive

scenes.voiceover: The Soviet Union deleted this man from history while he was still alive.
scenes.visualConcept: Real archival portrait of Nelyubov, hard punch-in, scratch-out energy.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Real archival portrait of Nelyubov, hard punch-in, scratch-out energy.

scenes.voiceover: In 1961, Grigori Nelyubov was one of three men shortlisted to become the first human in space.
scenes.mainText: 3 MEN. ONE SEAT. FIRST IN SPACE.
scenes.visualConcept: The real first-cosmonaut-group photo, slow push toward the faces.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: The real first-cosmonaut-group photo, slow push toward the faces.

scenes.voiceover: Gagarin flew. Nelyubov waited for his turn. Then one drunken argument with a military patrol ended everything.
scenes.visualConcept: MiG cockpit, cold military hardware, tension.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: MiG cockpit, cold military hardware, tension.

scenes.voiceover: He was expelled, exiled to the far east, and airbrushed out of every official photograph.
scenes.visualConcept: Group photo again — the erasure context the thumbnail promises.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Group photo again — the erasure context the thumbnail promises.

scenes.voiceover: At a remote airbase he told his fellow pilots the truth. I was Gagarin's backup. Nobody believed him. The proof was gone.
scenes.mainText: "I WAS GAGARIN'S BACKUP" — NOBODY BELIEVED HIM
scenes.visualConcept: His real training photo — the man mid-air on the trampoline, full of life.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: His real training photo — the man mid-air on the trampoline, full of life.

scenes.voiceover: In 1966, he was struck and killed by a train. His name stayed erased for twenty more years.
scenes.visualConcept: Dark Earth-at-night frame, a life swallowed by black.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Dark Earth-at-night frame, a life swallowed by black.

scenes.voiceover: He was not the only one. Six men were erased. The full story is on the channel.
scenes.mainText: 6 MEN WERE ERASED → FULL STORY ON THE CHANNEL
scenes.visualConcept: The group photo one last time — how many are missing?
scenes.backgroundPrompt: The group photo one last time — how many are missing?
